name: writing
description: Use this skill when writing or editing prose — blog posts, documentation, longform content, marketing copy. Covers voice, tone, structure, examples, language conventions (UK spelling, sentence case, em-dashes), and what to avoid (preachy tone, padding, opening summaries). For README files specifically, see the writing-readme skill. For UI microcopy (buttons, error messages, empty states), see the writing-copy skill.
when: When writing prose/documentation, voice, tone, structure, style
